fps.title: FPS Test
fps.howto: 1) Open the game and stand in the same spot/scene. 2) Press "Measure before boost" and switch to the game within 5 s. 3) Apply the boost, restart the game and "Measure after boost" in the same spot. BoostRoot calculates the difference.
fps.countdown: Switch to the game — starting in {0} s
fps.err.presentmon-missing: The FPS tool (PresentMon) is missing. Reinstall BoostRoot.
fps.err.noFrames: No frames captured. Was the game open and in front?
settings.chEnabled: Show crosshair when the game starts
settings.replay: Keep recording the last moments (save with Alt+F10)
settings.discord: Discord webhook URL (sends clips to a channel)
settings.hotkeys: Hotkeys: Alt+O overlay · Alt+C crosshair · Alt+F10 save last moments · Alt+F9 start/stop recording · Alt+F1 screenshot
settings.overlayNote: The overlay and crosshair never enter the game; they are separate windows on top, so they are safe with Vanguard/EAC and never appear in clips. Note: they may not show in exclusive fullscreen; borderless always works.
home.stretchNote: While the game runs the desktop switches to 4:3 filling the screen; it goes back when the game closes.
clips.title: Clips
clips.needFfmpeg: Clip recording needs the free ffmpeg tool (~100 MB, downloaded once from GitHub with checksum verification).
clips.installed: Ready ✓ Alt+F10 / Alt+F9 / Alt+F1 now work in game.
clips.noWebhook: First enter a Discord webhook URL in Settings → Clips.
clips.empty: No clips yet. In game, Alt+F10 saves the last moments, Alt+F9 records, Alt+F1 takes a screenshot.
clips.toast.noFfmpeg: Clips need ffmpeg — download it in BoostRoot → Clips
clips.toast.notReady: Recording not ready yet, wait a few seconds
home.noFileChanges: This game's settings file is not edited; driver and Windows settings are applied. In-game tips below.
change.windows: Windows: high performance power plan, Game Mode, background recording off, windowed game optimizations
change.gpu: Graphics card: low latency, V-Sync off (driver profile)
tools.advancedNote: Optional. Each one can be undone with one click. Some need a restart.
welcome.title: Welcome to BoostRoot
welcome.sub: Free, open-source FPS booster. Three promises before you start:
welcome.p1: It never touches your resolution, keybinds, sensitivity or crosshair.
welcome.p2: Every change is recorded and can be undone with one click. A Windows restore point is created before the first boost.
welcome.p3: Nothing is injected into games; it is safe with Vanguard, EAC and BattlEye.
update.failed: Couldn't download the update; you can download it from GitHub manually.
donate.tip: BoostRoot is completely free. If you like it, star it on GitHub and share it.
gpu.amd.title: AMD Radeon — recommended Adrenalin settings
gpu.amd.1: Gaming → pick your game (or Global Graphics): Radeon Anti-Lag ON.
gpu.amd.2: Competitive games (VALORANT, CS2, LoL…): Radeon Boost OFF; you can leave it ON for other games.
gpu.amd.3: Radeon Chill OFF, Wait for Vertical Refresh: Always Off.
gpu.amd.4: Texture Filtering Quality: Performance, Surface Format Optimization: ON.
gpu.amd.5: Auto overclock: Performance → Tuning → Automatic Tuning → "Overclock GPU". Then run BoostRoot → Stress → Graphics card for 15 min; on errors/crashes reset Tuning to "Default".
gpu.amd.6: BoostRoot doesn't change AMD driver settings itself (AMD offers no safe way), so it shows the steps.
gpu.nvidia.title: NVIDIA — automatic driver profile
gpu.nvidia.1: On Boost, BoostRoot writes a per-game NVIDIA profile: Power management = Prefer maximum performance, Low latency (max pre-rendered frames 1), V-Sync off, Texture filtering = High performance. Undo removes it.
gpu.nvidia.2: In games with Reflex, enable NVIDIA Reflex: On + Boost in game.
gpu.nvidia.3: Auto overclock: NVIDIA App → System → Performance → "Automatic Tuning". Then run BoostRoot → Stress → Graphics card for 15 min; on errors/crashes reset tuning.
fps.needTool: FPS measurement needs Intel's free PresentMon tool (~5 MB). The installer includes it; the portable version downloads it once.
fps.toolFailed: Download failed. Check your internet connection.
